row: University of Utah PT Residency Programs

The University of Utah Physical Therapy Residency Programs develop novice clinicians into advanced thinkers with the knowledge and skills for specialist level clinical practice. Resident engage in evidence-guided clinical practice in high impact, collaborative learning environments; one-on-one mentoring; focused didactics; clinical and academic teaching; professional development; and, clinical research.
